## 实际完整提示词

### A 水墨
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one complete square Rizhao cultural artwork for an internal experimental Shandong map.
INPUT IMAGE 1 is the actual Rizhao city template, supplied solely as a spatial composition reference. Treat the entire square reference, including its margins, as the entire output canvas, retaining the same position and proportions; do not crop, zoom, shift or rotate it. The application will later mask this complete artwork to the referenced irregular region with a separate exact vector path. Do NOT copy or show the geographic outline, template fill or its beige margin. Paint one seamless full-bleed square artwork with texture and color extending through every edge.

Make one clear, beautiful original Chinese ink-and-wash painting featuring a single imagined black-pottery high-stemmed vessel inspired by Longshan black-pottery heritage in the Rizhao region. This is not a specific museum artifact, archeological reconstruction, photograph or historical event. Make its cup bowl and sufficiently sturdy stem a simple bold ink silhouette. Place the bowl/identity core around x=0.50, y=0.462 of the full square reference canvas; design the complete vessel compactly within the broad central body of the referenced region, with the foot extending below the bowl, not into the narrow outer tips. Do not make the entire vessel a tiny icon. The subject must be recognizable on a small map without relying only on an extremely thin stem. Calm expressive washes of charcoal ink and muted ocean blue, light mineral-color accents, visible xuan-paper fibers and dry/wet brush character. A restrained original cut-paper rhythm inspired by Juxian festive door valances and flowing coastal light may accompany the hero but never compete; imaginary nature is atmospheric, not a claim about a specific location. No administrative outlines or map-shaped patches, no label, text, letters, digits, signature, seal, watermark, UI, frame or white margin; not a photo, poster or collage.

### B 工艺融合
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one complete square Rizhao cultural artwork for an internal experimental Shandong map.
INPUT IMAGE 1 is the actual Rizhao city template, used ONLY as a spatial composition reference. The entire square reference including all margins maps to the entire output square: no zoom, crop, stretching, repositioning or rotation. A separate vector mask will later cut the finished painting to the irregular area. Do not draw, trace or preserve the map outline, the gray-blue region, guide colors or the beige surround. Make one full-bleed work with handmade texture and color continuous across all four canvas edges.

The one dominant protagonist is an original imaginary black-pottery high-stemmed vessel, visually inspired by Longshan black-pottery heritage around Rizhao; it does NOT depict or reconstruct an actual archaeological object. Around full-reference position x=0.50, y=0.462, make the bowl and body striking and recognizable; fit the complete vessel compactly into the broad middle of the reference shape, with a sturdy leg and foot extending downward rather than into the narrow edges. Preserve a clear silhouette at small map size, without shrinking the subject to a badge. Style B combines tactile matte black fired clay and subtle original incised marks with a few Juxian-door-valance-inspired cut-paper shapes, hand-laid pigment, warm ochre, restrained cinnabar and deep blue-green on natural fibrous paper. This should have a materially distinct handmade identity from ink wash, not glossy CGI or a copy of an existing papercut. Flowing seaside motifs and paper fibers fill the surrounding scene as secondary creative atmosphere. No geographic boundary, no graphic frame, no template colors as guides, no letters, text, numerals, label, stamp, signature, watermark, UI or empty margin.
